improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon, the Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.jpg">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Your Claude-powered assistant for trade and business decisions. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: These meta tags improve search engine click-through rates by clearly communicating Gideon's value proposition and the free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. The copy highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, trade focus) and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without making unsubstantiated claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it's for (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a low-friction entry point by highlighting the free trial. The name 'Gideon' personalizes the AI, and 'today' adds subtle urgency without being pushy.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's full capabilities—including voice chat, your personal workspace, and professional trade and business support. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. It reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace) while clearly stating pricing, reducing uncertainty and building trust before the paywall appears.
